propositions: newly added hard-fail CI gates break branches created before the gate was defined, without grandfather logic to exempt in-flight changes
code-review criteria are dispatched unconditionally regardless of applies_to glob patterns, rendering file-based triggering ineffective for project criteria

a portable, CI-vendor-agnostic criterion is needed to detect hard-fail gates lacking if-present or grandfather guards, usable across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Buildkite, Bitbucket Pipelines, and Drone
applies_to glob patterns must gate project criteria dispatch by matching against changed files, with an empty applies_to preserving always-on behaviour for backward compatibility
project-specific CI configuration paths must be overridable via config key (applies_to_config_key) so unusual pipelines are declared, not hard-coded
the criterion must remain advisory during calibration before any blocking-gate transition
